stories.text: 🚨 MEDIAN FLIP: 49er Faith-Fool just moved below the projected league median.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Mr. Action Jackson vs Gibb it to Me Baby. Playoff odds with a win / loss: Mr. Action Jackson 78% / 50%, Gibb it to Me Baby 81% / 52%.
😬 Claremont In Yo Stace! would be leading Ruffing the Passer if they'd started Cam Skattebo over Devin Singletary — instead they trail by 13.90 pts.
⚡ Early edge: Gibb it to Me Baby went from 63% to 95.2% against Mr. Action Jackson, led by Likely (28.70 pts).
🎲 GUTSY CALL: Claremont In Yo Stace! started Singletary (NYG's RB2) over Skattebo. It backfired: Skattebo outscored Singletary by 26.90.
🎯 TWO WINS: Ruffing the Passer: 72% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 32% with none (now 57%).
📈📉 STOCK WATCH: Gibb it to Me Baby 66% → 79% playoff odds; Mr. Action Jackson 61% → 52%.
📈 LINE MOVE: JAX @ TEN: JAX −2.5 at open, JAX −10.5 now. News: "Jaguars holding out new players Jordan Davis, Jessie Bates to give them bye"
💥 BYE-MAGEDDON: Kyle Tucker has 3 starters on bye this week (Irving, Williams and Broncos D/ST). Somebody call *NSYNC.
🎯 8 teams are in the thick of the median race, with Kirbo Crushers right on the line (48%).
🎲 Claremont In Yo Stace! is rolling with 2 kickers and 3 TEs (LaPorta, Andrews and Strange). It's a bold strategy, Cotton. Let's see if it pays off for 'em.
👀 League gossip: Claremont In Yo Stace! may be wishing they trusted Cam Skattebo — 27.20 pts are sitting on the bench.
📈 Ruffing the Passer was down to 13% against Mr. Action Jackson — and won.
💓 Ruffing the Passer outlasted Mr. Action Jackson after the favorite flipped 8 times.
